prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. ONE square image, one scene, pure white seamless background, only the named referents and indispensable support, no bystanders or unrelated objects. Entire composition centered in central 70 percent with broad white margin ALL sides; whole figures and objects, correct natural anatomy, friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: friendly flat 2D educational drawing, no 3D. Exact target TASSA + AMB + NÚVOL. One plain ceramic mug with handle containing a small fluffy grey-white weather cloud. Cloud nestles visibly INSIDE the mug, its lower part enclosed by the rim and upper rounded lobes rising above rim. Cloud must have clear weather-cloud lobed silhouette and soft grey shading, not liquid, whipped cream, steam or foam. No rain, sun or other scenery. Only mug and its impossible cloud contents, whimsical school-friendly.
